sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Customer

SELECT COUNT(CustomerId) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'
SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent';
SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice
SELECT T1.Title FROM Album AS T1 JOIN InvoiceLine AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.InvoiceId JOIN Invoice AS T3 ON T2.InvoiceId = T3.InvoiceId WHERE T1.Title LIKE '%Greatest%'
SELECT CAST(SUM(T2.Milliseconds) AS REAL) / 60 FROM PlaylistTrack AS T1 JOIN Track AS T2 ON T1.TrackId = T2.TrackId
SELECT T2.Name FROM PlaylistTrack AS T1 JOIN Track AS T2 ON T1.TrackId = T2.TrackId WHERE T2.Milliseconds / 60 > 20
SELECT T2.GenreName, COUNT(T1.TrackId) FROM Album AS T1 JOIN InvoiceLine AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId GROUP BY T2.GenreId
SELECT T1.Name FROM Album AS T1 JOIN Artist AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId GROUP BY T1.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.Country, SUM(T2.Total) AS Revenue
FROM Customer AS T1
JOIN InvoiceLine AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId
GROUP BY T1.Country
ORDER BY Revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE YEAR(InvoiceDate) = 2023

```sql
SELECT 
    YEAR(InvoiceDate) AS Year,
    SUM(Total) AS TotalRevenue
FROM 
    Invoice
GROUP BY 
    Year;
```
SELECT T1.Title FROM Album AS T1 JOIN Artist AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId WHERE T2.Name = 'AC/DC'
SELECT T2.Name FROM Album AS T1 JOIN PlaylistTrack AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId JOIN Track AS T3 ON T2.TrackId = T3.TrackId WHERE T1.Title = 'Let There Be Rock'
SELECT T2.Name, COUNT(T1.TrackId) FROM PlaylistTrack AS T1 JOIN Playlist AS T2 ON T1.PlaylistId = T2.PlaylistId GROUP BY T2.Name

SELECT T1.Country, AVG(T2.Total) AS AverageTotal
FROM InvoiceLine AS T1
JOIN Invoice AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId
GROUP BY T1.Country;
SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo = (SELECT CustomerId FROM Customer WHERE FirstName = 'Nancy' AND LastName = 'Edwards')

SELECT T1.FirstName, T1.LastName, COUNT(T2.CustomerId) AS NumberOfCustomers
FROM Customer AS T1
JOIN Employee AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId
GROUP BY T1.FirstName, T1.LastName;

SELECT T1.PlaylistId, T1.Name FROM Playlist AS T1 JOIN PlaylistTrack AS T2 ON T1.PlaylistId = T2.PlaylistId JOIN Track AS T3 ON T2.TrackId = T3.TrackId GROUP BY T1.PlaylistId HAVING COUNT(T3.TrackId) > 1000

SELECT T2.GenreName, AVG(T3.UnitPrice) as AveragePrice
FROM InvoiceLine AS T1
JOIN Invoice AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId
JOIN PlaylistTrack AS T3 ON T1.TrackId = T3.TrackId
GROUP BY T2.GenreName;
SELECT T1.Composer FROM Playlist AS T1 JOIN PlaylistTrack AS T2 ON T1.PlaylistId = T2.PlaylistId JOIN Track AS T3 ON T2.TrackId = T3.TrackId WHERE T3.Quantity > 20

SELECT T2.Name, SUM(T1.UnitPrice * T2.Quantity) AS Revenue
FROM InvoiceLine AS T1
JOIN Invoice AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId
JOIN PlaylistTrack AS T3 ON T1.TrackId = T3.TrackId
JOIN Playlist AS T4 ON T3.PlaylistId = T4.PlaylistId
JOIN Genre AS T5 ON T4.GenreId = T5.GenreId
GROUP BY T5.Name
ORDER BY SUM(T1.UnitPrice * T2.Quantity) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.Name, COUNT(il.TrackId) AS TracksSold
FROM Album a
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON a.AlbumId = il.AlbumId
GROUP BY a.ArtistId
ORDER BY TracksSold DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T1.FirstName, T1.LastName FROM Customer AS T1 JOIN InvoiceLine AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId JOIN PlaylistTrack AS T3 ON T2.InvoiceId = T3.InvoiceId JOIN Playlist AS T4 ON T3.PlaylistId = T4.PlaylistId WHERE T4.Name = 'Jazz' GROUP BY T1.CustomerId, T1.LastName, T1.FirstName

SELECT T1.FirstName, T1.LastName, SUM(T2.Total) as Revenue
FROM Customer AS T1
JOIN Employee AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId
GROUP BY T1.FirstName, T1.LastName;
SELECT COUNT(T1.TrackId) FROM InvoiceLine AS T1 JOIN Invoice AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId WHERE T2.Quantity = 0

SELECT a.Title, CAST(a.Total / 60 AS REAL) AS Minutes
FROM Album a
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON a.AlbumId = il.AlbumId
JOIN Invoice i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
GROUP BY a.AlbumId
ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT a.Name FROM Artist a JOIN Album al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON al.AlbumId = il.AlbumId JOIN Invoice i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Playlist p ON i.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId JOIN Track t ON pt.TrackId = t.TrackId WHERE t.GenreId IN (SELECT g.GenreId FROM Genre g GROUP BY g.GenreId HAVING COUNT(g.GenreId) > 1)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Total > 5 * 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.TrackId) FROM InvoiceLine AS T1 JOIN PlaylistTrack AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId WHERE T2.TrackId IN (SELECT TrackId FROM Track WHERE Duration > 5 * 60)
SELECT FirstName, LastName, HireDate FROM Employee ORDER BY HireDate DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Customer WHERE CustomerId IN (SELECT CustomerId FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId HAVING SUM(Quantity * Price) / COUNT(*) > (SELECT avg(Total) FROM Invoice))

SELECT YEAR(InvoiceDate) AS Year, T2.Name AS GenreName, SUM(T3.Quantity) AS QuantitySold
FROM InvoiceLine AS T1
JOIN Invoice AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId
JOIN PlaylistTrack AS T3 ON T1.TrackId = T3.TrackId
JOIN Playlist AS T4 ON T3.PlaylistId = T4.PlaylistId
JOIN Genre AS T5 ON T4.GenreId = T5.GenreId
GROUP BY YEAR(InvoiceDate), T2.Name
ORDER BY YEAR(InvoiceDate) DESC, QuantitySold DESC;

```sql
SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', T1.InvoiceDate) AS Month,
    SUM(T2.Total) AS Revenue,
    T1.InvoiceDate - DATE_TRUNC('month', T1.InvoiceDate) AS RevenueChange
FROM 
    InvoiceLine AS T1
JOIN 
    Invoice AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId
JOIN 
    Customer AS T3 ON T1.CustomerId = T3.CustomerId
WHERE 
    T3.Company = 'Apple Inc.'
GROUP BY 
    strftime('%Y-%m', T1.InvoiceDate)
ORDER BY 
    strftime('%Y-%m', T1.InvoiceDate);
```

SELECT T2.Name, CAST(SUM(T1.Quantity * T2.Price) AS REAL) / SUM(T1.Quantity) * 100 AS Percentage
FROM InvoiceLine AS T1
JOIN Invoice AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId
JOIN MediaType AS T3 ON T1.MediaTypeId = T3.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY T3.Name;

SELECT T1.FirstName, T1.LastName FROM Customer AS T1 JOIN InvoiceLine AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId JOIN Invoice AS T3 ON T2.InvoiceId = T3.InvoiceId WHERE T3.InvoiceDate BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY T1.CustomerId, T1.FirstName, T1.LastName

```sql
SELECT a.Name, AVG(t.Total / t.Quantity) AS AverageMinutes
FROM Artist a
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON a.ArtistId = il.ReportsTo
JOIN Invoice i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
JOIN Playlist p ON i.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId
JOIN Track t ON pt.TrackId = t.TrackId
WHERE a.ArtistId IN (
    SELECT ArtistId
    FROM Artist
    GROUP BY ArtistId
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
)
GROUP BY a.ArtistId
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY AverageMinutes DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
SELECT T1.FirstName, T1.LastName, T2.FirstName, T2.LastName FROM Employee AS T1 JOIN Employee AS T2 ON T1.ReportsTo = T2.EmployeeId

SELECT SUM(T1.Total) AS RunningTotal, T1.Month FROM InvoiceLine AS T1 JOIN Invoice AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId WHERE T2.BillingDate >= '2022-01-01' AND T2.BillingDate < '2022-12-31' GROUP BY T1.Month ORDER BY T1.Month
SELECT PlaylistName FROM Playlist WHERE PlaylistId NOT IN (SELECT PlaylistId FROM PlaylistTrack)
SELECT count(*) FROM countries
SELECT iso3 FROM countries WHERE region = 'South Asia'
SELECT T2.capital_city FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T1.name = 'Japan';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countries WHERE income_group = 'Low income'
SELECT population FROM countries WHERE iso3 = 'IN' AND year = 2023
SELECT name, population FROM countries ORDER BY population DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT count(*) ,  income_group FROM countries GROUP BY income_group
SELECT T1.name FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.year = 2023 ORDER BY T2.gdp_per_capita_usd DESC LIMIT 1

```sql
SELECT 
    iso3,
    SUM(population) AS combined_population,
    year
FROM 
    country_stats
GROUP BY 
    iso3, 
    year
ORDER BY 
    year;
```

```sql
SELECT iso3, name
FROM countries
WHERE region = 'Sub-Saharan Africa'
  AND year = 2023
  AND life_expectancy_years > 70;
```
SELECT T2.unemployment_pct FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T1.name = 'Germany' AND T2.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2023 ORDER BY T2.year

SELECT T1.region, AVG(T2.fertility_rate) AS average_fertility_rate
FROM countries AS T1
JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3
WHERE T2.year = 2023
GROUP BY T1.region;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countries WHERE income_group = 'High income' AND gdp_usd > 1000000000000000000
SELECT T1.name FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T1.region = 'Europe & Central Asia' AND T2.year = 2023 ORDER BY T2.fertility_rate ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT year, gdp_usd FROM country_stats WHERE iso3 = 'USA' AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2023
SELECT T1.name FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.year = 2023 GROUP BY T1.region HAVING AVG(T2.internet_users_pct) > 70
SELECT SUM(population) - SUM(population) FROM country_stats WHERE year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2023

SELECT name, life_expectancy_years
FROM country_stats
WHERE year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2023
GROUP BY iso3
ORDER BY life_expectancy_years DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T1.name, T2.gdp_usd
FROM countries AS T1
JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3
WHERE T2.year = 2023
ORDER BY T2.gdp_usd DESC;
SELECT iso3 FROM countries WHERE region = 'Europe & Central Asia' AND gdp_per_capita_usd > (SELECT avg(gdp_per_capita_usd) FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2023)
SELECT AVG(population) FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2023 AND life_expectancy_years IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countries WHERE population < (SELECT population FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2023 AND iso3 = (SELECT iso3 FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2010))
SELECT T1.name, T1.region, T2.life_expectancy_years FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.year = 2023 AND T2.life_expectancy_years < 60

SELECT 
    T1.region,
    CAST(T2.population AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(T2.population) AS percentage
FROM 
    countries AS T1
JOIN 
    country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3
WHERE 
    T2.year = 2023
GROUP BY 
    T1.region;
SELECT iso3 FROM countries WHERE gdp_usd IS NULL AND year = 2023

```sql
SELECT 
    year,
    CAST(SUM(gdp_per_capita_usd) AS REAL) / SUM(population) * 100 AS GDP_growth_percentage,
    CAST(SUM(life_expectancy_years) AS REAL) / SUM(population) * 100 AS life_expectancy_percentage,
    CAST(SUM(fertility_rate) AS REAL) / SUM(population) * 100 AS fertility_rate_percentage,
    CAST(SUM(urban_population_pct) AS REAL) / SUM(population) * 100 AS urban_population_percentage,
    CAST(SUM(internet_users_pct) AS REAL) / SUM(population) * 100 AS internet_users_percentage
FROM 
    country_stats
WHERE 
    iso3 = 'France'
ORDER BY 
    year;
```

SELECT T1.name, T1.income_group, T2.gdp_per_capita_usd
FROM countries AS T1
JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3
WHERE T2.year = 2023
ORDER BY T2.gdp_per_capita_usd DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    region,
    CAST(SUM(population) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS population_percentage,
    CAST(SUM(life_expectancy_years) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS life_expectancy_percentage,
    CAST(SUM(fertility_rate) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS fertility_rate_percentage,
    CAST(SUM(urban_population_pct) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS urban_population_percentage,
    CAST(SUM(internet_users_pct) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS internet_users_percentage
FROM 
    country_stats
WHERE 
    year = 2023
GROUP BY 
    region;

```sql
SELECT iso3, name, gdp_usd, gdp_per_capita_usd, life_expectancy_years, fertility_rate, urban_population_pct, internet_users_pct
FROM country_stats
WHERE internet_users_pct < 10 AND internet_users_pct > 50
  AND year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2023;
```

SELECT T1.gdp_per_capita_usd AS GDP_per_capita, T2.life_expectancy_years AS life_expectancy_years
FROM countries AS T1
JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3
WHERE T2.year = 2023;
SELECT T1.region, T1.name, T1.population FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.year = 2023 ORDER BY T1.population DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT T1.region, T1.name, T2.unemployment_rate FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.year = 2020 ORDER BY T2.unemployment_rate DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.region, T1.year, AVG(T2.life_expectancy_years) AS avg_life_expectancy
FROM countries AS T1
JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3
GROUP BY T1.region, T1.year
SELECT count(*) FROM penguins;
SELECT COUNT(species) FROM penguins WHERE species = 'Gentoo';
SELECT DISTINCT island FROM penguins
SELECT max(body_mass_g) FROM penguins
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE sex IS NULL
SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins
SELECT species, COUNT(*) FROM penguins GROUP BY species
SELECT species, AVG(body_mass_g) FROM penguins GROUP BY species;

SELECT 
    island,
    year,
    COUNT(*) AS num_penguins,
    SUM(bill_length_mm) AS total_bill_length_mm,
    SUM(bill_depth_mm) AS total_bill_depth_mm,
    SUM(flipper_length_mm) AS total_flipper_length_mm,
    SUM(body_mass_g) AS total_body_mass_g,
    SUM(sex) AS total_sex
FROM 
    penguins
GROUP BY 
    island,
    year;
SELECT AVG(bill_length_mm) AS average_bill_length_male, AVG(bill_length_mm) AS average_bill_length_female FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'male' OR sex = 'female';
SELECT species FROM penguins GROUP BY species ORDER BY avg(flipper_length_mm) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT species, MIN(bill_depth_mm), MAX(bill_depth_mm) FROM penguins GROUP BY species
SELECT island FROM penguins GROUP BY island ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT species, sex, AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_body_mass
FROM penguins
WHERE sex != 'unknown'
GROUP BY species, sex;
SELECT species FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'male' AND body_mass_g / 2 > body_mass_g / 2
SELECT COUNT(species) FROM penguins WHERE bill_length_mm > (SELECT AVG(bill_length_mm) FROM penguins);

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.island = 'Biscoe' AND T1.species = 'Gentoo' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.species) FROM penguins AS T1 JOIN penguins AS T2 ON T1.species = T2.species WHERE T2.island = 'Biscoe'

```sql
SELECT species, year, COUNT(*) AS num_penguins
FROM penguins
GROUP BY species, year
ORDER BY species, year;
```
SELECT island FROM penguins GROUP BY island HAVING count(*) > 1
SELECT species, island, body_mass_g FROM penguins ORDER BY body_mass_g DESC LIMIT 1

```sql
SELECT species, AVG(body_mass_g) AS average_body_mass_2007, AVG(body_mass_g) AS average_body_mass_2009
FROM penguins
WHERE year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;
```
SELECT species, island FROM penguins WHERE flipper_length_mm > (SELECT avg(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins)

```sql
SELECT 
    species,
    AVG(bill_length_mm) AS avg_bill_length_mm,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_bill_length_mm DESC) AS rank
FROM 
    penguins
GROUP BY 
    species;
```
SELECT species, avg(body_mass_g) AS standard_deviation FROM penguins GROUP BY species;

SELECT FirstName, LastName, SUM(InvoiceLine.Price * InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS TotalSpent
FROM Customer
JOIN InvoiceLine ON Customer.CustomerId = InvoiceLine.CustomerId
GROUP BY Customer.CustomerId
ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC
LIMIT 3;
